$comment: Modules defining their own deterministic JSON serializer instead of importing shared/canonical-json.ts. This list may only shrink. Re-point the call site, then regenerate with npm run ci:canonicalizers:write-baseline — but read the migration note in shared/canonical-json.ts first: changing a call site's serializer changes the digests it produces, so any stored hash written by the old copy stops reproducing. Adding an entry by hand is a regression, not a fix.
